top5.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO
top5.description: Jensen Huang has reportedly resigned as Nvidia’s CEO following reports of two alleged affairs with Chinese spies. Nvidia’s valuation fell by $800 billion after the controversy.
top5.why: Jensen Huang’s reported departure from Nvidia would be a major leadership and market shock, with potential consequences for the AI-chip ecosystem and Nvidia’s valuation.

top5.title: A Global Microsoft 365 Outage Affects Outlook and Teams
top5.description: A global Microsoft 365 outage disrupted Outlook, Teams, Copilot, and other services. Microsoft attributed it to an overloaded secure-connections process and said it was not a cyberattack.
top5.why: The global Microsoft 365 outage highlights the operational and concentration risks businesses face when core email, collaboration and AI services depend on one cloud provider.

top5.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for Coding Assistants
top5.description: Google has launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a model designed for coding assistants and software that uses tools. It accepts text, images, audio, and video, with adjustable reasoning levels and usage-based pricing.
top5.why: Google’s Gemini 4 Hydrogen strengthens competition in coding and tool-using AI, potentially affecting developer workflows, model economics and enterprise adoption.

top5.title: Companies are divided over AI agents’ access to commerce
top5.description: Amazon, Booking.com, eBay, Target, Resy, Yelp, and other companies are taking different approaches to third-party agents, ranging from blocking them to approving certain platforms. Companies will therefore choose where and how they participate in the agentic web.
top5.why: Companies are now making strategic decisions about whether and how AI agents may access commerce, shaping the next distribution layer between businesses and customers.

top5.title: Google Unveils Intelligent Eyewear, the Successor to Google Glass
top5.description: These new smart glasses let users use Gemini in everyday life to ask questions, take photos, and translate conversations. Preorders are open, and deliveries will begin on December 10.
top5.why: Google’s new Gemini-powered smart glasses signal a renewed race to make ambient AI a mainstream consumer interface beyond phones and computers.
